violations.description: Preventing contamination during storage. — --Food item was not stored in a clean, dry location a minimum of 6 inches above the floor. -Boxes of food on the floor in the walk in freezer.

Cleaning frequency of equipment and utensils. — --Nonfood contact surface was not cleaned as frequently as required. -Back side of the refrigerator in the kitchen is dusty. Dust buildup on the fans in the walk in cooler and freezer.
Handwashing lavatories. — --Handwashing lavatory was used for purpose other than handwashing. -Handwash sink was blocked at the beginning of the inspection.

Design and construction of floors, walls, and ceilings. — --Floors, walls, and/or ceiling were not constructed or designed to be smooth, nonabsorbent, and easily cleanable. -Acoustic ceiling tiles in the kitchen.
Preventing contamination during storage. — --Food item was not stored in a clean, dry location a minimum of 6 inches above the floor. -Box of food on the floor of the walk in freezer.
Ventilation hood systems - Design and construction. — --Ventilation hood system was not provided over all cooking equipment. -Starting to stain the walls where the air fryers are used.
Cleaning frequency of equipment and utensils. — --Nonfood contact surface was not cleaned as frequently as required. -Fans in the walk in cooler are dusty.
Storage of cleaned equipment and utensils. — --Clean equipment/utensil was not covered or inverted during storage. -Hot dog trays are not inverted on the shelf for customer use.

Handling and storage of poisonous and toxic materials. — --Poisonous or toxic material was not stored in a manner to protect against contamination of food, equipment, utensils, linens or single-service items . -WD-40 and other chemicals on a shelf above the 3 comp sink.--Secondary container of poisonous or toxic material was not clearly identified to indicated contents. -Water bottles with chemicals in them are not labeled.
